pending-clause.answer: GR4 defines which declarative is 'applicable', the word §2002:14.5.12.1.2 item 2 and §2002:14.5.12.1.3 item 2 use. 2023's fatal and nonfatal processing differs from §2002:14.5.12.1.2/1.3 only by additions with no 2002 counterpart (the PERFORM WHEN path, §2023:14.6.13.1.3; SORT/MERGE and fatal EC-I-O steps; APPLY COMMIT rollback); the 2002 sequence (conditional phrase, declarative, PROPAGATE, abnormal termination, implementor-defined when unchecked) is 2023's without them, and §2002:14.5.12.2 differs only by 2023's floating-point arms. 2023's PERFORM WHEN path, which takes precedence over a declarative, has no 2002 counterpart. Witnesses pb369 (formats 1 and 2) MATCH at --std 2002.
